name: The First Thread
summary: Help Meadowrest stir the First Loomstone and reveal the path to the five.

steps.objective: Meet Mara beside Meadowrest's dormant Loomstone.
Pick up the worn hatchet by the western path.
Open your pack and equip the worn hatchet.
steps.guidanceText: Open Pack below, then choose Equip beside the Worn Hatchet.

steps.objective: Chop three Meadow Logs in the western grove.
steps.guidanceText: Follow the gold marker to the western oaks. One tree can supply all three logs as it regrows.

steps.objective: Collect the worn pickaxe at the quarry entrance.
Equip the worn pickaxe.
steps.guidanceText: Open Pack below, then choose Equip beside the Worn Pickaxe.

steps.objective: Mine three Copper Ore from the northern quarry.
steps.guidanceText: Follow the gold marker into the northern quarry and work any copper outcrop.

steps.objective: Find the worn fishing rod near the southern bridge.
Equip the worn fishing rod.
steps.guidanceText: Open Pack below, then choose Equip beside the Worn Fishing Rod.

steps.objective: Catch two Riverlings from the shoal.
steps.guidanceText: Follow the gold marker south to the rippling shoal beside the bridge.

steps.objective: Cook a Riverling at the village fire.
steps.guidanceText: The gold marker shows the village cooking fire. Bring at least one raw Riverling.

steps.objective: Take the militia sword beside the eastern gate.
Equip the militia sword.
steps.guidanceText: Open Pack below, then choose Equip beside the Militia Sword.

steps.objective: Defeat the restless skeleton at the eastern training ground.
steps.guidanceText: Follow the gold marker east. Make sure the Militia Sword is equipped before engaging.

steps.objective: Return to Mara in Meadowrest.
Place your hand on the First Loomstone.

name: The Forge's Trade
summary: Village iron is thin work, but the quarry has copper enough to start. Learn what Meadowrest's forge can make.

steps.objective: Mine four Copper Ore from the northern quarry.
steps.guidanceText: Return to the gold-marked copper outcrop. Any quarry outcrop counts.

steps.objective: Smelt two Copper Ingots at the Meadowrest Smelter.
Forge a Copper Battleaxe at the Anvil.
Equip the Copper Battleaxe.
steps.guidanceText: Open Pack below and equip your newly forged Copper Battleaxe.

name: The Verdant Loomstone
summary: Meadowrest's threads are strong again. Prove it, and a second Loomstone will answer.

steps.objective: Strengthen every Meadowrest skill to level 5.
steps.guidanceText: Open Skills below to track Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, and Smithing. Train each to level 5.

steps.objective: Tell Mara the five threads are ready.
Walk north to the grove and wake the Verdant Loomstone.

name: The Grove's Gift
summary: The awakened grove offers a living thread. Harvest it carefully and learn what the new hearth can make.

steps.objective: Harvest two Heartwood Logs from the awakened grove.
steps.guidanceText: Follow the gold marker into the awakened northern grove and harvest a Heartwood Bough.

steps.objective: Brew a Verdant Tonic at the Grove Hearth.
steps.guidanceText: The gold marker shows the Grove Hearth. You also need one raw Riverling.
